title: Stephen A. Smith Talks Midterms With Ron DeSantis & More
summary: Throughout the week, Stephen A. will also sit down with Chris Sununu, Terry McAuliffe, Frank Luntz, and more.
body_markdown:
[Stephen A. Smith](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/stephen-a-smith) is offering his perspective on the issues driving the 2026 midterm elections and speaking with a slate of guests during a midterms week special of *Straight Shooter with Stephen A.*


[Straight Shooter with Stephen A. POTUS Politics Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogStraightShooterWithStephenAMidterms)


Stephen will speak to Florida Governor Ron DeSantis, former Governors Chris Sununu and Terry McAuliffe, Rep. Glenn Ivey, CBS News’ Robert Costa, political pollster Frank Luntz, and MeidasTouch’s Scott MacFarlane.


On Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday, *Straight Shooter with Stephen A.* will air live from the Washington, D.C. studio in front of an audience.


### How to Listen


Tune in to *Straight Shooter with Stephen A.* on POTUS (Ch. 124) Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday from 6-8pm ET.


### Straight Shooter with Stephen A.


Straight Shooter with Stephen A. airs on SiriusXM’s bipartisan POTUS channel (Ch. 124) every Wednesday at 6pm ET.


“Straight Shooter” welcomes notable figures from the worlds of politics, entertainment, business, and beyond, while offering Smith’s trademark no-nonsense commentary on the day’s most pressing headlines. The show also gives listeners the chance to join the conversation, with Smith taking live calls from across the country.
